expected: BS-P1-007 F02/F03/F04 must provide a closed, exact machine schema for every executable Blueprint substructure consumed by T002, including requiredness, exact key sets, identity grammar, finite bounds, Value Source lexical context, and capability-local optional state representation, so implementation cannot change admission semantics by choosing defaults.
actual: Fresh T002 pre-write audit and an independent same-class schema completeness sweep found four blocker groups. B1: capability_state RECORD optional fields are semantically required but TypeDescriptor has no optional-field machine token. B2: F04 action args allow SCOPE while F02 has no action dispatch-site repeat-scope typing context. B3: top-level and nested Blueprint executable substructures are not closed as exact required/optional key sets, most visibly Node. B4: repeat/result/support/kind/intake and related bounded schema details lack canonical grammar or numeric limits. The independent sweep extends B3/B4 to the full T002 executable schema surface so remediation is one-shot rather than issue-by-issue.
evidence: B1 — F04 logic.random capability_state uses last_number?/last_index?/last_item? and F04 rule 7 says capability_state RECORD fields may be optional; F02 TypeDescriptor RECORD only has constraints.fields and Blueprint RECORD initial keys are exact. F03 ABSENT depends on optional declared fields. No exact optional-field representation exists.

B2 — F04 logic.random and logic.score action args explicitly allow SCOPE. F02 only defines SCOPE root as current repeat item descriptor and says SCOPE only in repeat scope; Blueprint actions are top-level. EVENT has all-dispatch-site typing, but SCOPE has no corresponding action dispatch-site lexical environment.

B3 — V02 says required keys / allowed keys only, but F02 does not freeze exact requiredness/key sets for every nested executable structure. Node is only exemplified, leaving empty props/bindings/events/children omission ambiguous and therefore content_hash/admission-sensitive. Same-class sweep includes Meta, Support, Degradation, Mutable/Derived State entry variants, Rule, CapabilityRef, Node, Repeat, Action, ActionStep variants and Result/ResultOutput.

B4 — repeat item_alias/index_alias/max_items, ResultOutput id/label/sensitivity, degradation requirement_id/description/capability_refs element shape, top-level kind domain, and V01 candidate intake byte ceiling are not fully fixed. These are admission-visible schema choices.

Independent schema completeness sweep reviewed F02 §§4–22 plus F03/F04 cross-contract consumers. Value Source variant keys, state-key grammar, Rule/Action/Node IDs, TypeDescriptor core constraints, EVENT path grammar, Registry v3 resolver, candidate_digest, persistence/immutability and existing global major resource ceilings were already sufficiently fixed and are not reopened.
